independenceRationale: The two qualifying studies are separate material-conditioning and injection-moulding experiments from different research teams. One uses measured residual moisture with controlled plasticisation experiments on TPU and polycarbonate and physical appearance outcomes; the other independently examines polyamide and TPU drying or residual-moisture condition and moulded quality defects. They are not duplicate publications or re-analysis of one dataset.
promotionClaim: Promote the mechanism-level statement that measured material moisture and drying state can alter moulded physical part-quality and that a dryer setpoint alone does not establish material condition at the machine. Do not promote any moisture percentage, dryer temperature, residence time or plasticising value as a universal material limit; current supplier grade data and approved site procedures remain authoritative for production.
